title: Meal Bazar: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Mobile-Money Slip world. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Mobile-Money Slip
options.lineage: The cash-out / Send Money confirmation slip every Bangladeshi reads daily (generic, not any provider's brand)
options.thesis: Every entry is a receipt. The month bill is a slip that explains itself line by line.
options.viewport: The Today screen as one running slip: a large Bangla date, the meal total as the headline amount, a tally grid of members × meals, and a dashed tear line above the quick-action row.
options.risk: If the slip motif goes decorative (fake zigzags everywhere), it turns kitsch. Perforation is reserved for totals.

options.label: Split-Flap Meal Board
options.thesis: Today's meals as a departure board: members are rows, meal types are columns, and the cells flip 1 / ½ / 0.
options.viewport: A dark board with fixed character cells, with the active meal column lit amber.
options.risk: Low audience recognition in Dhaka, and a dark-only grammar fights daylight use.
options.case: Fuses well for the meal grid itself, but weaker for bazar, money and bills. It wins clarity on one screen and loses identification.

options.label: Monochrome Product Canon
options.thesis: Near-black on near-white with one accent, where every number is paired with its proof.
options.viewport: A clean neutral Today screen with an accent primary button.
options.risk: Indistinguishable from every SaaS app, so it fails 'unique style'.
options.case: Fuses cleanly but carries no Bangladeshi identity. Clear, forgettable.

options.label: Centre-Rail Ledger
options.thesis: Twin columns around a vermilion rail of keys, ruled at one pixel.
options.viewport: Two dense columns of members and figures around a date rail.
options.risk: Tiny type and hairline controls break the 48dp touch and 1.3× text-scale rules.
options.case: Fuses poorly because dense book typesetting fights Bengali script and thumb input.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Standard Material 3 finance app: tonal cards, a green primary and a bottom nav, executed well.
canonCard.viewport: A top app bar, summary cards, a chart, and a FAB.
